doc.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: The Chamber Jazz Sextet's Pal Joey date
summary: He wrote one chart, The Lady Is a Tramp, for a group from the Stanford area, remembering little.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Probably so. I‟m looking at another record date here, Plays „Pal Joey.‟The reason why I bring up this date, this is a chamber jazz sextet. It included french horn and bassoon. You did arranging for this. Let me see if you have any recollections about that date. French horn and bassoon are not something that you normally see. These guys are doubling, obviously. Do you remember that? The Pal Joey, obviously this is a soundtrack.
It‟s called the Chamber Jazz Sextet Plays Pal Joey. Allyn Ferguson, french horn, piano.
Yeah. They were from up north, around Stanford. I think Allyn was going to Stanford. So it‟s around there. I think they had me write one chart
The Lady is a Tramp is what they have you listed here.
Did you actually use the bassoon and french horn on that – on your chart?
